title: Project Submission & Next Steps
description: Submit your project and explore resources to continue your Vue journey.

slides.title: How to Submit
slides.content:
# Share Your Work

Once your app is deployed, you can submit it in the course platform (or share with the community). Include:

- Live URL
- GitHub repository link
- Brief description of the features
- What you learned

If you're taking this course independently, consider sharing on Twitter, LinkedIn, or the Vue.js forum to get feedback.

slides.title: Where to Go from Here
slides.content:
# Continue Learning Vue

Congratulations! You've completed the Vue.js course. Here are some next steps:

- **Build more projects** – practice makes perfect.
- **Explore the ecosystem** – Nuxt.js (framework), Vuetify (UI library), VueUse (collection of composables).
- **Contribute to open source** – find Vue projects on GitHub.
- **Read the official docs** – the Vue documentation is excellent and covers advanced topics.
- **Join the community** – Discord, forums, meetups.

slides.title: Final Advice
slides.content: Remember: **the best way to learn is by building**. Keep coding, keep breaking things, and keep improving. You now have the skills to build sophisticated web applications with Vue. Go make something awesome! 🚀

quizData.question: What is a recommended next step after completing this Vue course?
